headword: {感染者数|かんせんしゃすう}
gloss: number of infected people; case count

definitions.gloss: number of infected people; number of cases
definitions.explanation: How many people have been confirmed to have caught a particular infectious disease, usually reported for a given day or region.

examples.japanese: {感染者数|かんせんしゃすう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{減|へ}って→減る：01985_heru⟧きた。
examples.english: The number of infected people has been falling.

examples.japanese: ⟦{昨日|きのう}→昨日：00859_kinou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{感染者数|かんせんしゃすう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{百人|ひゃくにん}→百人：10985_hyakunin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{超|こ}えた→超える：01942_koeru⟧。
examples.english: Yesterday's case count exceeded one hundred people.

examples.japanese: ⟦{検査|けんさ}→検査：02707_kensa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{数|かず}→数：00204_kazu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{限|かぎ}られている→限る：02033_kagiru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、⟦{発表|はっぴょう}→発表：03562_happyou⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧{感染者数|かんせんしゃすう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{実際|じっさい}→実際：02502_jissai⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦{少|すく}ない→少ない：01136_sukunai⟧とみられる。
examples.english: Because the number of tests is limited, the announced case count is thought to be lower than the real figure.

notes:
⟦{感染者|かんせんしゃ}→感染者：28388_kansensha⟧ (infected person) + ⟦{数|すう}→数：03360_suu⟧ (number, count). Became everyday news vocabulary during the coronavirus pandemic and is now the standard way of reporting case figures.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {感染者数|かんせんしゃすう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}える→増える：01183_fueru⟧: for the number of cases to rise
- ⟦{新規|しんき}→新規：06289_shinki⟧{感染者数|かんせんしゃすう}: the number of new cases
- {感染者数|かんせんしゃすう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{発表|はっぴょう}する→発表する：25231_happyousuru⟧: to announce the case count

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{感染率|かんせんりつ}→感染率：30144_kansenritsu⟧: infection rate — a proportion rather than a headcount
- ⟦{死者数|ししゃすう}→死者数：30171_shishasuu⟧: death toll — the same ⟦{数|すう}→数：03360_suu⟧ pattern applied to deaths
